wholesale.policy: Six annual expenditure columns only; log1p then sample-SD standardization; full 440-row descriptive fit; Channel and Region are supplementary; signs anchored by largest absolute coefficient; no customer quality or causal ranking.

surveyScoring: T3=6−raw; preserve NA; each 3-item domain requires >=2 answered items; alpha uses complete cases within its stated item set; no automatic quality exclusions.
units: UCI monetary units per year; no currency or observation year invented
